label: FATEs
tooltip: Which FATEs Illegal Mode is allowed to do, and when to skip ones that are already far along.

max_fate_progress_percent.label: Skip FATEs at or above (% progress)
max_fate_progress_percent.tooltip: Do not start a FATE that is already this far along. 0 = never skip. FATEs you are already in are finished.

disabled_fate_ids.label: Allowed FATEs
disabled_fate_ids.tooltip: Check a FATE to do it. Uncheck to skip. While Prefer pot FATEs is on, Magic Pots stay on and show as required.
disabled_fate_ids.empty: No FATEs listed for this zone.
disabled_fate_ids.forced_note: Prefer pot FATEs is on — Magic Pots are required.
disabled_fate_ids.forced_by_prefer: Required while Prefer pot FATEs is on. Turn that off if you want to skip this pot.
